claim_one_line: THE DECLARATION GAP (the deep spine sweep over the 541 substantive non-instrument arcs B1210's criterion did not reach). THE FINDING IS NOT A MISSING CLAIM CANDIDATE BUT A REGISTRATION GAP: SEVEN OF THE PROGRAMME'S EIGHT MOST RECENT OBSERVER-LAYER RESULTS (B1182, B1183, B1184, B1192, B1196, B1200, B1203) SIT ON NO REGISTERED SYNTHESIS SURFACE AT ALL -- not LAW_MAP, not THEOREM_REGISTRY (whose last row was B1145), not the SM ledgers; only B1195 appears anywhere. THE MECHANISM, and it is sharper than B1207's 'a gate only works where it is reached': gate_theorem_registry enforces 'declared creates_law=true => has a registry row', which catches OVER-declaration and is blind to UNDER-declaration -- and the seat that writes the claim also writes the flag, so THE GATE INHERITS THE SEAT'S JUDGEMENT. This seat declared creates_law=false on an arc literally titled THE ONE-CLASS THEOREM, so no row was ever required, so B1210's mechanical pool (creates_law + the registered surfaces) could not see it, and only the memory-written spec carried it. A GATE THAT READS A SELF-DECLARED FIELD IS ONLY AS GOOD AS THE DECLARATION. THE REPAIR: six arcs corrected to creates_law=true, each with a DATED creates_law_corrected note (claim, verdict and evidence untouched), and six THEOREM_REGISTRY rows landed in the same commit -- the one-class theorem, the quine split verdict, the relational bit's existence, selector-freedom + the three-regime dichotomy, the Phi_3 three-faces law, and the C4' named-action torsor identification. THE CONTROL: B1203 was reviewed and STAYS false on its own words ('an interpretation joining banked facts, not a theorem') -- a review that flipped everything it looked at would be a sweep, not a judgement. THE COUNTER-CHECK INSTALLED, AND IT FIRED IMMEDIATELY ON TWO MORE: declaration_check.py flags arcs whose claim talks like a theorem while the flag says otherwise, and on installation it caught B1185 (THE THREE-MECHANISMS THEOREM -- pairwise distinctness by three exact invariants; FLIPPED, seventh registry row added) and B1204 (the SHAPE of a forcing theorem -- a taxonomy of this corpus's own arguments, not a new theorem about the object; REVIEWED AND KEPT false). The lock accepts EITHER a flip OR a dated recorded decision: what it forbids is SILENCE. Locked FORWARD-ONLY from B1180 (history is never flipped; 26 corpus-wide candidates recorded, not retro-flipped). THE INSTRUMENT NEEDED ITS OWN SCOPE CORRECTION, the THIRD of that species in one session (after B844's greedy regex and B1210's claim-scope matcher): a global disown-list containing 'cited, not' and 'harvest' LOST B1183 AND B1200, because those words appear in the FENCES of genuine theorems where an arc limits a BORROWED computation rather than its own result; fixed to strong self-limits in the HEADLINE region only. THE REUSABLE FINDING: the memory-written spec caught the observer theorems the mechanical pool missed, and the pool caught the older forced material the spec missed -- NEITHER ALONE IS SUFFICIENT, and the two are complementary rather than redundant. Fences: the detector is lexical, screening not adjudicating (it caught 3 of the 6 arcs judged by reading and missed three whose claims state their results without the word THEOREM); coverage of the remaining unswept arcs as paper claim candidates is NOT claimed. Gate 5 clean.
